what_changed: Hardened ai_jobs enqueue semantics so identical idempotency keys return deterministic existing jobs unless explicit terminal retry is requested.
Extended week insight path to return bounded 7-day metrics with immediate rule fallback and AI-derived next action only when already available.
Preserved non-blocking behavior by keeping reflection projection persistence off the request-critical path via background submission.
Added Phase2 stabilization tests for lifecycle determinism, delay/failure fallback, week insight behavior, and Phase1 regression safety.

validation.name: phase2_async_fallback_and_lifecycle_pytest
validation.command: .\tools\project_python.ps1 -m pytest -q tests/test_gateway_fastapi.py -k "phase2_ai_job_lifecycle_and_polling or phase2_insight_fallback_when_ai_jobs_fail or phase2_ai_job_idempotency_is_deterministic or phase2_core_loop_non_blocking_under_ai_delay_and_failure or phase2_week_insight_uses_ai_when_available"

risks.description: Legacy reflection projection still depends on narrative logic internals that can emit Streamlit context warnings in bare background threads.

next_3_actions: Merge this backend evidence with frontend/android phase2 iteration artifacts for CT pass/partial/block verdict.
Observe AI failure/delay rehearsal with identical commands to confirm fallback behavior remains deterministic.
Schedule optional cleanup to decouple reflection projection from Streamlit session context.
